rejected_recommendation.evidence_assessment: The single allowed evidence item (ev-misev2023-quality-framework) provides strong, consensus-level guidance that supports gating on robust CMC and analytics. However, there are no SGL-001–specific data or validation reports in the reviewed evidence set to evaluate the program-level claims; therefore the available evidence is insufficient to change program state or support advancement.
findings: MISEV2023 (ev-misev2023-quality-framework) clearly frames expectations for transparent, orthogonal characterization, defined release criteria, validated intact-EV assays, and mechanism-linked potency assays prior to cross-species bridging or lot-comparability claims.
The allowed evidence set contains only MISEV2023; no SGL-001–specific CMC, analytical-validation, stability, batch-comparability, MCB/WCB, or intact-EV–specific biodistribution records were provided.

Because program-specific documentation is absent, program-level gating claims (that SGL-001 does or does not meet identity/potency/CMC requirements to advance) cannot be supported or refuted from the provided evidence.
objections: Absence of SGL-001 program-specific CMC and analytical-validation records (MCB/WCB characterization, validated intact-EV assays with LLOQ/specificity/precision, stability-indicating potency correlation, GMP-like batch comparability, and intact-EV–specific biodistribution data) prevents confirmation or refutation of the program-level gating claim.

claim_updates.rationale: Consensus guidance supports the principle of gating, but no SGL-001–specific validation or manufacturing evidence is present to support this claim.
claim_updates.statement: SGL-001 meets the CMC/analytics gating criteria required to advance to cross-species PK/PD and lot-comparability studies.

claim_updates.rationale: MISEV2023 outlines expectations for cell-banking and scale-up documentation, but no program-specific MCB/WCB or scale-up run records were supplied in the reviewed evidence.
claim_updates.statement: MCB/WCB documentation and scale-up records demonstrate reproducible, GMP-like production for SGL-001.

claim_updates.rationale: MISEV2023 mandates orthogonal intact-EV detection and controls to attribute in vivo signal to EVs; no SGL-001–specific intact-EV biodistribution data with appropriate orthogonal controls were provided.
claim_updates.statement: Rodent intranasal biodistribution data demonstrate intact-EV CNS delivery that is predictive/cross-bridgable to other species.

decision_update.question: Should SGL-001 advance to cross-species PK/PD and lot-comparability studies now?
decision_update.rationale: Available evidence is limited to MISEV2023 guidance; program-specific CMC/analytics and biodistribution data required to justify advancement have not been provided.

proposed_changes.editorial_clarification: When referencing MISEV2023 in program claims, explicitly distinguish consensus guidance from program-supplied validation data; do not treat MISEV compliance statements as substitution for submission of program records.

hypothesis_update.rationale: MISEV2023 supports these gating principles; current program evidence is absent, leaving the hypothesis untested.
hypothesis_update.statement: Advance SGL-001 into cross-species PK/PD and lot-comparability studies only after demonstrating fit-for-purpose CMC/analytics (MCB/WCB, validated intact-EV assays, stability-indicating potency, reproducible GMP-like lots, and intact-EV–specific biodistribution).

proposed_changes.next_action: Assemble and submit the Stage-1 CMC/analytics package: (1) MCB/WCB characterization and banking records (identity, sterility/mycoplasma, stability/passaging); (2) analytical validation reports for an orthogonal intact-EV QC panel with fit-for-purpose metrics (LLOQ/ULOQ, specificity, intra-/inter-assay precision, accuracy/recovery, robustness); (3) a validated, stability-indicating potency assay mechanistically linked to an in vivo PD endpoint and data demonstrating correlation; (4) release and stability data from ≥3 GMP-like production runs with comparability analyses; (5) rodent and large-animal biodistribution/toxicology reports using intact-EV–specific detection methods with orthogonal and negative controls. Submit raw data, validation summaries, SOPs, and batch records for review.

risk_updates.description: Absent or unvalidated analytics and lack of batch comparability could cause misattribution of biological effects and uncontrolled product variability.
risk_updates.mitigation: Require submission of the Stage-1 CMC/analytics package and independent review of validation and comparability data prior to advancement.
risk_updates.title: Insufficient identity and potency characterization

risk_updates.description: Without intact-EV–specific detection, biodistribution signals may reflect non-vesicular components, limiting translatability.
risk_updates.mitigation: Require intact-EV–specific biodistribution studies with orthogonal and negative controls in rodents and a large-animal model.
risk_updates.title: Uncertain cross-species intact-EV CNS delivery attribution

risk_updates.description: Lack of validated potency assay linked to in vivo PD undermines ability to compare lots or predict efficacy.
risk_updates.mitigation: Develop and validate a stability-indicating potency assay with demonstrated correlation to an in vivo PD endpoint.
risk_updates.title: Model/assay generalizability risk

rejected_recommendation.recommendation: Do not advance SGL-001 into cross-species PK/PD bridging or lot-comparability conclusions based on the current evidence set. Require submission of a Stage-1 CMC/analytics package (see Next Action) before any major therapeutic or advancement decision. Any decision to advance must undergo human approval and remains pending.

unsupported_conclusions.conclusion: Guidance (MISEV2023) supports the principle that transparent, orthogonal characterization, clear release criteria, and validated functional assays are required prior to advancing product comparisons or cross-species bridging; however, no SGL-001-specific CMC/analytical validation data are provided in the allowed evidence set, so program-level support for the gating statement cannot be established from available evidence alone.
unsupported_conclusions.evidence_gap: Program-specific CMC and analytical-validation data (MCB/WCB records, validated intact-EV assays with performance metrics, stability/potency correlation data, and reproducibility across  GMP-like batches) are missing.

unsupported_conclusions.conclusion: MISEV2023 articulates manufacturing- and characterization-related expectations that justify gating on CMC/analytics before advancing formulations; however, the allowed evidence set does not include program-specific manufacturing records or comparability data for SGL-001, so the claim that current materials 'do not demonstrate' scalable, reproducible production cannot be confirmed from the provided evidence.
unsupported_conclusions.evidence_gap: Lack of program manufacturing records and scale-up/comparability data to evaluate the disputed claim.

unsupported_conclusions.conclusion: MISEV2023 supports the need for orthogonal characterization and appropriate controls to avoid misattributing signal to non-vesicular material, which underpins the requirement for orthogonal QC, validated intact-EV assays, and mechanism-linked potency assays before formulation advancement; nevertheless, SGL-001-specific validation and biodistribution data are not present in the allowed evidence and are required to verify program assertions.
unsupported_conclusions.evidence_gap: Absence of SGL-001 experimental/validation evidence (orthogonal intact-EV data, assay performance, cross-species biodistribution comparability) in the reviewed evidence set.

Existence of GMP‑like production run records, release specifications, stability results, and batch‑to‑batch comparability data for SGL‑001 in the reviewed evidence set.
